description: Calculates bridge temperature actions with the Bridge Thermal Loads plugin's own engine: shade air and effective bridge temperatures, the uniform ranges ΔT_N,con / ΔT_N,exp (and bearing ranges), the vertical temperature difference (linear Approach 1 or the non-linear code profile, as depth/temperature points), CS 454 / BS 5400 combined X − Y values, and the simultaneity combinations, each with its clause. Codes: EN 1991-1-5 + UK NA (default) or CEN, CS 454, BS 5400-2:2006 / 1978. Needs no model.

T0.description: Initial (restraint) temperature, °C. Default: the code's value where it gives one.

code.description: EN 1991-1-5 with the UK NA (default) or the CEN values, CS 454, BS 5400-2:2006 or the legacy BS 5400-2:1978.

kind.description: Deck type: steel_box, steel_plate (truss or plate girders), composite (concrete deck on steel girders), concrete_slab, concrete_beam, concrete_box.

loads.description: Load types to generate (each gives two cases). Default: uniform and difference.

bearing.description: Bearing / joint ranges (USER cases, not for structural combinations).

combined.description: CS 454 / BS 5400-2:2006 combined X − Y distributions (EC1T_Comb_*, used INSTEAD of Uniform + Difference).

method.description: Temperature difference: approach2 = non-linear profile (code profiles), approach1 = linear. Default: the code's (the CEN text leaves it to the annex — then it must be given).

modularRatio.description: Es/Ec, needed for combined cases on composite sections (LR 765 effective temperature).

procedure.description: Composite decks under EN: normal or simplified procedure.

sections.description: Deck sections. For one section the shorthand kind / h / D may be used instead.

h.description: Depth for the profile, m: the slab depth for composite decks, the overall depth otherwise.

kind.description: Deck type: steel_box, steel_plate (truss or plate girders), composite (concrete deck on steel girders), concrete_slab, concrete_beam, concrete_box.

parts.description: Width against depth, for the band forces and combined cases.

z1.description: Top of the part, m below the top of the deck.

site.description: For the uniform component (and bearing / combined cases). Tmin / Tmax are the shade air temperatures read from the code's maps by the user (the maps are not built in), °C.

returnYears.description: Default: the code's basis (50 for EN).

trussReduction.description: Steel truss / plate girder reduction where the code gives one.

name: bridge_thermal_calc
title: Bridge thermal actions (EN 1991-1-5 / CS 454 / BS 5400-2)
